## Bio

Dafa Briliant Herdiansyah is a third-year Civil Engineering student at Nanyang Technological University, currently working as a Summer Research Intern at Rice University's Doss-Gollin Lab.
Dafa is deeply interested in climate-resilient infrastructure systems, flood risk modeling, and sustainability.
He brings technical and project management experience from previous internships at Siemens Mobility and Obayashi Singapore, as well as an international perspective from his academic exchange at Boğaziçi University.

## Education

- **Nanyang Technological University** | Singapore<br />B.Eng. in Civil Engineering, Expected 2027
- **Boğaziçi University** | Istanbul, Turkey<br />Academic Exchange Program, Fall 2025
